messages:
emma: Quick one — we need a single-page GA preflight playbook that covers SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing backstops for enterprise & PLG customers. I put a rough owner map in the doc. Can owners confirm by EOD?

raj: saw the doc. linking here: https://internal.redwood/drive/GA-preflight-v1 (please comment) :eyes:

liz: on SLA: propose 99.9% monthly uptime for hosted free/standard, 99.95% for dedicated with dedupe window. p95 targets by model class, p99 soft targets.

mike: +1. Also need a clear incident schedule for SLA breaches (pager -> follow-ups -> credit calc). Who owns the credit calc formula?

olivia: finance can take the credit calc. I suggest formula = min( committed_monthly_fee, (downtime_fraction * monthly_revenue_for_tier) * multiplier ). i'll draft.

sam-cs: CS/solutions: need ready-to-send onboarding checklist for Dedicated & Private (networking steps, certs, KMS, data residency doc). Can engineering produce a concise checklist (3–5 steps) we can paste into deals?

emma: yes — eng-platform will do checklists. assign mike for SLA runbook, raj for monitoring alerts, olivia for credits/pricing backstop, liz for GA SLO doc, sam-cs for customer-facing onboarding.

mike: SLA runbook notes (draft):
```
- Incident class: P1 (total production outage), P2 (partial degraded), P3 (minor)
- Escalation: on-call -> eng lead (30m) -> SRE lead (60m) -> exec oncall (3h)
- Remediation window targets per class & credit triggers
```

sre-bot: New alert policy created by raj: "GA-p99-regression" -> notify #eng-oncall + #product when p99 latency > 2x baseline for 10m

raj: monitoring: add golden signals per route (latency, error rate, saturation). Also add a lightweight prompt-regression metric: daily eval on a tiny evaluation set for generation quality drift. If quality drops > X% we rollback to previous model variant.

liz: docs: We Need three artifacts: 1) public docs (what customers see), 2) internal runbook (oncall + escalation + credit calc), 3) sales one-pager (pricing tiers + burst/backstop rules). I'll draft public docs + sales one-pager.

mike: rollouts + fallback policy: canary at 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health gates. If p99 or error rate crosses threshold, auto-fallback to previous compatible model variant. Need SRE signoff on auto-fallback window.

olivia: pricing backstop: for beta customers we cap charges at X; for GA customers we need a clearly advertised burst policy and a committed-burst plan for Dedicated. I'll send numbers.

sam-cs: legal/compliance asks from a Fortune 10 prospect: SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, audit logs, deletion SLA. Can product commit to these for Private by GA?

emma: SOC2 + audit logs yes. KMS/HSM integration for Private planned for GA but dependent on partner QA — mark as "GA with caveat" in the playbook. Deletion SLA: 30 days for Private, 90 days for hosted. call it out.

olivia: commercial note: require a clause that Dedicated SLA excludes customer-managed infra outages (network, customer auth). Product/legal to provide exact wording.

raj: test plan for burn-in: 72h synthetic traffic with production-like distributions + random fault injection (30s GPU preemption) to validate autoscaler and cache warmup. Document pass criteria (error budget consumption < 5%).

mike: rollback triggers to document: sustained p99 > SLA threshold for 15m, error rate > 2% for 10m, failed canary health checks. Add manual override mention.

liz: timeline ask: we have 4 working days to finalize playbook before sales kickoff. Can owners triage edits tomorrow morning? :calendar:

emma: ack. owners please leave comments in the doc by 11am PT tomorrow. i'll collect and post a final one-pager then. :thumbsup:

sam-cs: will prepare the onboarding checklist template and sample network ACLs.

raj: I'll add the Prometheus/trace rule snippets to the doc. small snippet below: 
```
alert: GA_P99_Regression
expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) > 0.002
for: 10m
labels: { severity: "page" }
```

mike: adding a note — for Dedicated we need a pre-provision verification call with infra (30m handshake) before cutting traffic. Put on the checklist.

olivia: i'll draft the pricing fallback clause and post it in the doc.

emma: Thanks all — this is actionable. If we hit blockers, escalate to me. Will produce final single-page GA preflight by EOD tomorrow.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for canary/ga-playbook-test at 1% (triggered by raj)
